title: Little Garage Mahal - East End/East Nashville
description:
New construction (2019) with modern finishes. Full second floor of detached garage. Private entrance from alley with outdoor parking directly beside building. Quiet neighborhood. Walking distance to East Nashville's famous Five Points (0.4 miles) area.  Shopping and restaurants start within 0.2 miles.  Easy 5 min. Uber ride into downtown/Lower Broadway area. 

Easy access to Nissan Stadium (1.4 miles) for football/concerts/events.

Keyless entry.

The space
The space
This apartment is above a detached garage in the backyard of our 1930s home. We are located on a quiet street in Historic East End, and are walking distance to many local restaurants, shopping, and bars. Just 2 miles from Titans stadium and downtown, we also are near Shelby Park that is full of beautiful green spaces and grounds.

The space has keyless entry, a queen bed, walk in closet, wifi, tv, dining table with 2 stools, couch, full bath, fully equipped kitchen.

Features:
› queen bed (w/memory foam topper - NEW 9/2020)
› walk in closet
› full kitchen with dishwasher
› full size bathroom
› couch/chaise (pulls out into double bed)
› tv with Netflix and Hulu
› coffee and tea station
› hair dryer
› full length mirror
› iron and ironing board
› garage space available for bicycles, etc. upon request

Hi, I'm a husband and father of two, originally from Western Pennsylvania, north of Pittsburgh. I've lived in Nashville since 2000, working in the music industry. We've been in our neighborhood since 2005 and absolutely love it.

Even though my family takes advantage of living a city that is buzzing with entertainment, good food, and lots of development, we love getting out of the city for backpacking, hiking, and backcountry canoeing.

We love getting to know our guests, but are always happy to give you as much space as you want.
